hero.lead: On an island registered as a UNESCO World Natural Heritage site, explore nature with certified guides. We offer safe, thoughtful journeys through forests, night wildlife, and vibrant shores — stories only Amami can tell.

home.missionBody1: We are an NPO dedicated to protecting the rare wildlife and unique ecosystems of Amami Ōshima and its surrounding islands, and sharing their importance through nature experiences and cultural exchange.
home.missionBody2: Amami was designated a UNESCO World Natural Heritage site in 2021. As more visitors come to the island, we work with certified guides to promote sustainable tourism that minimizes impact on nature.
home.ctaLead: Reservations and inquiries by phone. Feel free to ask about program selection.

about.title: About Us
about.lead: An NPO protecting Amami's rare nature and sharing its appeal through experiences and cultural exchange.
about.missionLead: Amami Ōshima was registered as a UNESCO World Natural Heritage site in 2021. As more visitors are expected, we address the island's nature from three perspectives as a civil organization.

conservation.title: Environmental Conservation
conservation.body: We work to protect the rare plants, animals, and endemic ecosystems of Amami Ōshima and its surrounding areas, preserving them for future generations.

experience.title: Experience & Education
experience.body: We plan and operate observation and experience events, providing opportunities to connect with nature and culture, and spreading awareness of their importance.

research.title: Research & Communication
research.body: We conduct research on rare wildlife and ecosystems, sharing findings through our website and social media.

history.text: Hiroshi Kubo and fellow enthusiasts began study sessions on environmental protection in Amami.
A founding meeting was held to determine the mission, articles of incorporation, and business plan.
An inaugural general meeting was held. The establishment of the corporation and its officers were approved.
Incorporated as a specified non-profit organization (NPO) (establishment registration).
Continuing nature experience programs with certified guides, along with research and awareness activities.

orgTable.name: Organization
orgTable.activitiesValue: Planning & operating nature experience/observation events / Research on rare wildlife & ecosystems / Environmental conservation awareness & cultural exchange

tours.title: Experience Programs
tours.lead: From wildlife observation to sea & river activities, mountain hikes, and island cultural experiences — we introduce the charms of Amami in many ways.
tours.reservationText: Reservations and applications by phone. Feel free to inquire about content, duration, fees, and more.
tours.note: ※ Program content and times may change due to weather, seasons, tides, etc. Please call to confirm availability.

wildlife-watching.title: Wildlife Observation
wildlife-watching.summary: Observe the rare Amami Black Rabbit and other endemic wildlife unique to Amami, experiencing both daytime and nighttime encounters.

sea-kayak-canoe.title: Sea Kayak & River Canoe
sea-kayak-canoe.summary: Explore calm coves and mangrove-lined rivers by kayak or canoe — a popular program offering a unique water-level perspective.

river-play.title: River Swimming & Play
river-play.summary: Spend a refreshing time in crystal-clear streams, searching for river creatures. Suitable for families with children.

diving-snorkeling.title: Diving & Snorkeling
diving-snorkeling.summary: Peek into Amami's underwater world of vibrant coral reefs and colorful tropical fish.

tidepool.title: Tidepool Exploration
tidepool.summary: Look into tidal pools to discover the lively world of small sea creatures. A wonderful opportunity for close observation.

fishing.title: Boat & Shore Fishing
fishing.summary: Fish in Amami's rich waters — from a boat or the rocky shore. Experience the joy of fishing and the bounty of the sea.

trekking.title: Mountain Trekking
trekking.summary: Walk through subtropical forests, sensing endemic plants and the spirit of the forest. Beginner-friendly courses available.

island-food.title: Island Food Experience
island-food.summary: Gather and taste Amami's local specialty ingredients. An immersive experience in the island's food culture and way of life.

shima-uta.title: Shima-uta, Dance & Sanshin
shima-uta.summary: Experience the traditional songs, dances, local dialect, and sanshin (shamisen) passed down through generations on Amami.

town-walk.title: Island Town Walk
town-walk.summary: Stroll through town tracing the island's history, culture, and traditional crafts like mud-dyeing and weaving.

old-trail.title: Ancient Trail Walk
old-trail.summary: Follow old paths once traveled by locals, reflecting on the history of life in Amami.

camp.title: Camping Experience
camp.summary: Spend a night in nature under the stars, surrounded by the sounds of the Amami night — a unique outdoor experience.

island-life.title: Island Homestay
island-life.summary: Stay with a local family and experience the rhythm of island life. The connections you make become cherished travel memories.

whale-watching.title: Whale Watching
whale-watching.summary: Meet the whales that visit Amami's waters from winter through spring. Watch their majestic presence from the deck of a boat.

location-coordinate.title: Filming Location Coordination
location-coordinate.summary: From location scouting to on-site arrangements for all types of shoots. Our staff, who know Amami's nature inside out, will support you.

access.title: Access
access.lead: Information on our office location, transportation options, and parking.
access.mapTitle: Map of the Amami Nature Experience Council office area

plane.title: By Airplane
plane.body: From Amami Airport, head toward Sumiyou-cho by car. Direct flights are available from major cities, with connecting flights via Kagoshima Airport.

car.title: By Car
car.body: Rental cars are the most convenient way to get around the island. Detailed directions to the meeting point will be provided when your reservation is confirmed.

parking.title: Parking
parking.body: Parking spaces are available at our office. You are welcome to drive directly to us.

contact.title: Contact / Reservation
contact.lead: Phone is the most reliable way to make reservations and inquiries. Please feel free to contact us.
notes: Program content and times may change due to weather, tides, etc.
For same-day or next-day reservations, please call.

footer.description: Protecting the rare nature of UNESCO World Heritage Amami Ōshima for the future. With care for conservation and a commitment to safety, we guide diverse nature experiences from forests and rivers to the sea and island culture.
